text:
Lena Ortiz: quick sync  testing two lightweight entry patterns for first-run: visual card strip (carousel) vs ultra-minimal starter bar (thin persistent). comps: https://figma.redwood/onboard/cardstrip.png and https://figma.redwood/onboard/starterbar.png
Marco (Design): card strip shows sample thumbnails which increase curiosity. starter bar is low-friction and plays nicer on small screens.
Ivy Chen: mobile is huge for us. starter bar takes less real estate. card strip could push down important content.
Ravi (Eng): starter bar is simpler to implement. card strip needs lazy image loading and snapshot tests for layout shifts.
Kira (a11y): both need attention: card strip must provide alt text for images and consistent keyboard carousel controls; starter bar needs clear aria-labels and a focusable dismiss action. also color contrast on the primary CTA in card comp is 3:1 currently  needs AA.
Marco (Design): noted, i'll update CTAs. quick copy brainstorm: 
```
Card headline: "Hands-on sample apps"
Card CTA: "Open sample"
Bar headline: "Get started with a template"
Bar CTA: "Start now"
```
Lena Ortiz: which CTA mapping feels clearer?
Ivy Chen: short verbs work better on small CTA buttons. "Start now" vs "Open sample"  both fine but pick one per pattern.
Ravi (Eng): for analytics, event names: onboard.entry_impression, onboard.entry_click, onboard.template_use. Ivy can you confirm events?
Ivy Chen: yes i'll add them to tracking plan and tag Jordan for dashboards.
Marco (Design): proposal: run 2-week experiment, 50% starter bar, 50% card strip, only for new orgs. measure click-through and template create.
Kira (a11y): also include screen-reader only testing for both in the QA checklist. i'll volunteer to run quick tests on staging.
Lena Ortiz: decision lean starter bar for initial launch (less layout risk) but we still run experiment to validate card lift. action items: 1) Marco update contrast + focus states 2) Ravi flag: exp.onboard.entry_pattern.v1 rollout 50/50 3) Ivy wire events and dashboards 4) Kira a11y checklist run post-build.
Ravi (Eng): will stub feature flag and add per-user preference to dismiss the starter bar ("hide for now"). note: persist setting via user prefs API.
ExpBot: Created feature flag exp.onboard.entry_pattern.v1 (50% card_strip / 50% starter_bar).
Marco (Design): uploading updated frames to Figma and adding accessible tokens: https://figma.redwood/onboard/frames_v2
Ivy Chen: adding events to tracking doc: /drive/onboard/tracking_entry_v1. tagging @growth for conversion monitoring.
Kira (a11y): checklist I'll run: tab order, screen reader announce, color contrast, focus visibility, dismiss semantics. will post results in this thread.
Lena Ortiz: thanks team. will reconvene in 10 days to review early metrics. :sparkles:
